chapter_title_en: Stirring Winds Beyond the Seas; Years Lost in Cultivation
chapter_seo_title: Han Li's Twenty-Year Seclusion: External Incarnation & Three Revolutions Art
chapter_meta_description: Han Li endures six years of mental torture to master the Great Derivative Art's second layer. Then he performs the External Incarnation ritual, splitting his soul into Qu Hun. The preparation for the Three Revolutions Heavy Origin Art begins.
og_title: Twenty Years, One Incarnation: Han Li's Longest Grind
og_description: A brutal six-year headache, a successful soul-splitting, and a radical self-dismantling technique. Han Li's quiet cultivation marathon ends with a rare moment of unguarded triumph.
twitter_title: Twenty Years of Cultivation: Han Li Masters External Incarnation
twitter_description: Han Li endures a six-year mental hell to complete the Great Derivative Art's second layer and successfully splits his soul into Qu Hun. Then comes the hard part.

lore_anchors.definition: A foundational mental cultivation technique from the Thousand Bamboo School; it strengthens divine sense and enables the Soul Divide technique for controlling multiple puppets.
A secret art that splits the cultivator’s soul into a prepared body (here, Qu Hun), creating a secondary independent self.

A dangerous technique that requires the cultivator to voluntarily disperse their cultivation from late Foundation Establishment back to early, compressing true essence toward solidity to ease the Core Formation bottleneck.
The soulless corpse-servant created from Zhang Tie’s body, now being refined into Han Li’s External Incarnation.
A dark-aligned core alternative formed through demonic cultivation methods; its formation cannot advance beyond the early Core Formation stage.
The personal flame a cultivator can produce once reaching the Foundation Establishment stage; required for refining high-grade pills.
